cause: The training pipeline applied log1p (natural log of 1 + x) to feature f4, but the serving pipeline uses the raw value. Training f4 values are in [0.65, 3.79] while serving f4 values are in [0.92, 43.28]. For every matched entity, train_f4 == ln(1 + serve_f4) to high precision (e.g., entity E0002: train=2.696, serve=13.816, ln(14.816)=2.696). All other features (f1-f3, f5) match exactly between training and serving.
